clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there's a part of your mind that doesn't think - it just reacts. He calls it the reactive mind, and when it's running the show, people can push your buttons without even trying.

Say the wrong word to someone and watch them light up: "Oh, he triggered me." That's not a choice - that's the reactive mind firing on autopilot, and anyone who knows the right button can control them like a puppet on a string.

Eliminate the reactive mind, Kevin says, and you can still respond to anything - you just can't be pushed around anymore.

What's the one thing people say that still gets you every time?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #emotionalcontrol #selfmastery #subconsciousmind #mindovermatter

Kevin Trudeau teaches something nearly nobody practices: leave space between stimulus and response.

Most people react instantly - no pause, no processing, just a reflex. Then they say, "I didn't mean to say that." But if you didn't mean it, Kevin asks, why did you say it?

Because you reacted. It wasn't a conscious choice - it was your reactive mind talking before you did.

Eliminate that part of the mind, Kevin says, and you become incredibly powerful.

Give yourself that half-second. It changes what comes out of your mouth next.

#kevintrudeau #mindset #selfcontrol #emotionalintelligence #personalgrowth #selfmastery
